attrs.evidence: docs/spec/proof-wire/experiment/run_state.mjs -- RUN_MEMBERS, RUN_ADAPTER_MEMBERS and ROLES, applied by runProblems() inside verifyRun() BEFORE any semantic check, so an open or ambiguous record is refused without a further check being attempted; blind_contract_revision compared against the release's experiment_revision. governance/blind_run.mjs writes records through the frozen renderRun(), so the written shape and the verified shape are one decision in one file. Falsifiers AA5 (verdict_override + revealed), AA6 (blindness on an adapter), AA7 (the instrument_files seat put back, zeroed, with an honest digest), AA10 (role "arbiter" with the record RE-IDENTIFIED around it so run_id agrees), and AA8 the positive dual. Gate `gov-spec` and `gov-nest`; grid boolean run-vocabulary-closed.
attrs.statement: THE RUN RECORD IS EVIDENCE, SO ITS OWN VOCABULARY IS CLOSED. P4.7.6 wrote eight closed shapes for the RESULT and the receipts and left `blind-run.json` open -- the record those artifacts are ABOUT. REPRODUCED: `verdict_override: "COMPLETE_AND_VERIFIED"` and `revealed: true` added to the shipped record left BLIND-RUN green with run_id untouched; `blindness: "DISQUALIFIED"` on an adapter did the same; `role` was bound into the run identity and never checked against a vocabulary, so a record re-identified around `role: "arbiter"` was legal; and `instrument_files` -- excluded from runCore precisely BECAUSE it is a rendering of instrument_digest -- could have its rows zeroed while the digest stayed honest, which is the authenticated-rendering-nobody-consumes class removed from the RESULT one round earlier. EVERY MEMBER IS NOW DERIVED OR CHECKED AND THERE IS NO NON_AUTHORITATIVE MEMBER AT ALL, because the three that would have been one are REMOVED: `instrument_files` (derivable from instrument_digest, the frozen INSTRUMENT set and the tree, and BLIND-RUN already recomputes it), `note` (prose in a machine record, P3.1's retired notes seat), `supersedes` (it named a run the receipt chain deliberately does not reach, so the only honest check for it would require a receipt the chain rule expressly declines to require -- it is printed by `--pin`, a human act, and recorded in the ledger). `abort_reason` went the same way, into the ABORTED receipt's declared note. AND `blind_contract_revision` WAS THE LAST MEMBER NOTHING READ: it is bound into the run identity and was never compared with the release it claims to be a revision of.
